rationale: No patched braces release exists (advisory range <=3.0.3, latest 3.0.3). npm audit proposes Tailwind CSS 4 as the parent fix. This app stays on Tailwind 3 because a v4 migration changes the styling toolchain and is out of scope. braces is used only through Tailwind/chokidar/micromatch file watching and glob expansion during local CSS builds, not in the production bundle or against untrusted pattern input. Revisit when braces publishes a patch or when a Tailwind 4 migration is planned.
